name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Promotes apprenticeship training by sharing stipend with employers and providing industrial skill training.
benefits: Monthly stipend support (25% up to ₹1,500/month by Govt) + on-the-job industrial certification

criteria.description: Applicant must be at least 14 years old
Applicant must be a student or job-seeker looking for apprenticeships
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant occupation is not eligible for apprenticeship training
